note: Graded relevance authored from the corpus narrative, never pooled from what either lane returned. Split from the retrieval inputs deliberately: the vectors are consumed by a lane and must be mountable into one, while these judgments are the ANSWER and must never be. A lane that could read this file could rank to it.

Q21.note: `-1` is deliberate and non-standard: retrieving a retracted claim or an unpromoted peer assertion is not neutral in this system, it is the failure the architecture exists to prevent, so it must cost rather than merely fail to score.

structuralRecallSubset.note: Gold items whose surface text shares no vocabulary term with the query. Reaching them requires a typed edge, an alias resolution, or a temporal interval, so this is the metric that decides whether structure adds retrieval signal at all.
